today.liveTrackingPaused: Live status tracking is paused. Quick status changes below are disabled — log this period via <askAi>Ask LogbookAI</askAi> or <logs>Logs</logs> instead.
today.timelineCorrectionRequired: Timeline correction required. HOS calculations are unavailable until elapsed coverage is continuous and conflict-free.
today.noInspectionToday: No inspection report logged today yet.
today.vehicleUnsafe: Vehicle should not be operated if unsafe.
today.dvirReminder: Reminder: review vehicle condition before finishing your work period and report any defects.
today.cycleAvailabilityNote: Cycle availability based only on records entered in LogbookAI. Prior duty history was not provided, so cycle balance is not verified until enough history exists to cover your {{cycleDays}} cycle.

settings.languageDescription: Choose the app's display language. Ask LogbookAI understands both English and Spanish either way — exported PDFs, DVIR/IFTA reports, and certifications always stay in English.

more.title: More
more.aiUsedThisMonth: {{used}} used this month · Voice Log does not count against this
more.appearanceNote: System follows your device setting. Voice Log and basic logging work in any appearance.
more.dvirReminderDescription: Optional. Reminds you near the end of your work period to review vehicle condition. A no-defect written DVIR is not federally required every day for property-carrying CMVs.
more.resetAiUsage: Reset all AI usage this month
more.defaultRuleset: US Interstate Property - Standard Federal Rules
more.deleteAccountBody: This permanently deletes your LogbookAI data and signs you out. This action cannot be undone.
more.deleteAccountError: Could not delete account. Please try again or contact support.
more.timezoneSuggestionNote: Suggested from your home terminal city. Changing it only affects how times are displayed — your saved log entries are not moved.
more.cycleChangeNote: Changing the cycle will not rewrite prior certified calculations.
